title: Moving a ShieldCare Plan to a New Owner
content:
A Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan moves to a new owner with the item only where the plan
allows transfer and the plan is still standing active, and the transfer fee of the plan is billed
to the party asking for the transfer.

The coverage window, the cover remaining, the claims already counted and the repairs already
authorised all move with the plan. The new owner inherits the history rather than a fresh plan.

A serial correction is not a transfer: where the serial recorded at the sale is wrong and the right
serial belongs to the same purchase, the record is corrected with no fee and no change of owner.

A plan on a fleet record is not transferred item by item. The whole record moves, or none of it
does.

A plan that has been terminated for non-payment, cancelled or declared void does not transfer, and
the item's new owner is offered a fresh plan under the admission rules.

### The rule as a table of cases

| Fact recorded | The rule's answer |
| --- | --- |
| Plan allows transfer and stands active | The plan moves with the item and the transfer fee is billed to the party asking |
| Plan allows transfer but stands held while a claim is under review | It is not standing active, so the plan does not move |
| Plan does not allow transfer | The plan does not move, whatever its standing |
| Wrong serial recorded, the right serial on the same purchase | Corrected with no fee and no change of owner |
| One machine on a fleet record is sold on | The record moves whole or not at all |
| Plan terminated for non-payment | No transfer; the new owner is offered a fresh plan under the admission rules |
